heads.author: p_4c2dbbafa3e4534493cac8ff
heads.title: POST /tasks takes {title} with a bearer token
heads.decision: POST /tasks, body {"title": string (1-200 chars)}, header Authorization: Bearer <POCKET_TOKEN>. Responds 201 with the created task {id, title, done:false}.
heads.rationale: Matches the existing GET /tasks shape; bearer tokens are what the CLI already reads from env.

heads.author: p_6ae0107a3cc7a824414b71ef
heads.title: POST /tasks takes {title, due?} with X-Api-Key
heads.decision: POST /tasks, body {"title": string, "due"?: ISO date}, header X-Api-Key: <key>. Responds 201 with {id}.
heads.rationale: The CLI wants to support due dates soon; API keys are simpler to paste.
